April 5, 2026 | Natural Disasters Summary

Northern Jutland | Denmark - Storm Dave brought winds up to 35-36 m/s, damaging roofs, roads, and buildings across the region.

Republic of Dagestan | Russia - Heavy rainfall triggered a second flood in a week, inundating hundreds of homes and streets in Makhachkala.

Adana | Turkey - Powerful storm with heavy rain and hail flooded streets, collapsed a retaining wall, and forced rescues from stranded vehicles.

Mayon Volcano | Philippines - Minor Strombolian activity was recorded at Mayon Volcano early in the morning.

Rogaland, Agder | Norway - Storm Dave brought record wind gusts up to 42.7 m/s, causing power outages, transport shutdowns, and infrastructure damage.

Gothenburg | Sweden - Storm Dave caused widespread damage, rail paralysis, and left thousands of homes without power.

April 5-6, 2026 

Durban, KwaZulu-Natal | South Africa - Torrential rain caused widespread flooding, damaged homes and roads, and created dangerous travel conditions.

Lublin, Łódź, Warsaw | Poland - Hurricane Dave brought strong winds up to 110 km/h, causing power outages and hundreds of emergency operations.

Cianjur, Lombok, Jakarta | Indonesia - Heavy rainfall caused flooding, damaged homes and roads, disrupted trains, and partially collapsed part of Terminal 3 at Soekarno-Hatta Airport.

Balneário Camboriú, Camboriú | Brazil - Intense rainfall up to 160 mm caused flooding, road closures, and school cancellations.

Ischia Island | Italy - Forest fire on the slopes of Monte Epomeo burned several hectares before being fully extinguished.

Lachen, Sikkim | India - Landslide blocked the Lachen-Chungthang route and stranded about 1,500 tourists, prompting a large evacuation operation.

#Flooding #Storm #Wildfire #Landslide #ExtremeWeather #NaturalDisaster #ClimateEvents #GlobalWeather #EarthNews #ALLATRA
